  html:
    page-layout: full
---

This project explores the visual aesthetics and cover art designs of **1,788 albums** spanning 8 major music genres (Pop, Rock, Hip-Hop, R&B/Soul, Country, Electronic, Latin, and Jazz). 

Every album cover has been computationally analyzed for:

- **Dominant Color Palette:** Primary RGB hues and dominant hex swatches.
- **Brightness Balance:** Mean luminance across the artwork (0% dark to 100% bright).
- **Vibrancy & Saturation:** Intensity and purity of color (monochrome to hyper-vivid).
- **Design Contrast:** Grayscale standard deviation measuring visual sharpness and composition depth.

---

## Complete Catalog (1,788 Albums across 8 Genres)

Use the search bar and column filters below to explore the full dataset, view cover artwork, and inspect extracted color swatches.

```{r}
#| label: catalog-table
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| echo: false

library(tidyverse)
library(DT)

pop_albums <- read_csv("pop_albums.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

pop_albums |>
  mutate(
    Cover = sprintf('<img src="%s" width="50" height="50" style="border-radius: 6px; object-fit: cover;" alt="%s" loading="lazy"/>', cover_thumbnail, album),
    Color = sprintf('<span style="display:inline-block; width:22px; height:22px; background-color:%s; border:1px solid #cbd5e1; border-radius:4px; vertical-align:middle; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.15);" title="%s"></span>', hex_color, hex_color)
  ) |>
  select(Cover, Color, Artist = artist, Album = album, Genre = genre, Year = year, Palette = palette, Brightness = brightness, Saturation = saturation) |>
  datatable(
    options = list(
      pageLength = 15,
      searchHighlight = TRUE,
      autoWidth = TRUE
    ),
    escape = FALSE,
    rownames = FALSE
  )
```
